description: This file defines string utility functions for string splitting, trimming, joining, comparison, prefix/suffix consumption, replacement, and error string conversion in the android::base namespace. It provides function declarations and template instantiations for string manipulations used across Android codebase.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of strings based on delimiters.

methods.name: Tokenize
methods.description: Splits a string into coalesced tokens, ignoring delimiters at edges.

methods.name: std::string Trim(T && t)
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the beginning and end of a string, supporting various string types.

methods.name: std::string Join(const ContainerT & things,SeparatorT separator)
methods.description: Joins a container of strings or string-like elements into a single string separated by a specified separator.

methods.name: StartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given prefix, case-sensitive.

methods.name: StartsWithIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given prefix, ignoring case.

methods.name: EndsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix, case-sensitive.

methods.name: EndsWithIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix, ignoring case.

methods.name: EqualsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if two strings are equal, ignoring case.

methods.name: bool ConsumePrefix(std::string_view * s,std::string_view prefix)
methods.description: Removes the specified prefix from the start of a string view if present.

methods.name: bool ConsumeSuffix(std::string_view * s,std::string_view suffix)
methods.description: Removes the specified suffix from the end of a string view if present.

methods.name: StringReplace
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of a substring with another substring within a string.

methods.name: ErrnoNumberAsString
methods.description: Converts an errno value to its corresponding error message string.
